method: Static music-format conversion and native Web Audio playback
driverReference: PRG bank 0x3E mapped at 0x8000, used as a data-format specification only
originalDataPreserved: DPCM compressed percussion decoded to PCM
signed one-way pitch slides with key-off and next-note reset
separate fine pitch and timer-period detune controls
synthesisDifferences: Web Audio oscillators replace the NES sound hardware
pulse duty-envelope motion is reduced to initial duty
noise uses filtered native white noise
timing is musical-event timing, not CPU-cycle or APU-frame timing
hardware sweep and tied-note oscillator/envelope phase are not fully reproduced

boss.callSite: native boss routine F956 sound queue

sfxLimits: Automatic shots are silent in the original mapping and can be replaced by a custom file. Browser synthesis differs from original hardware.

tests.scheduler: 8 stage/boss tracks each simulated for 10 minutes, 170302 scheduled notes, no invalid note times/gates and no prematurely stopped channel loops
tests.browser: Trusted-click playback running with nonzero analyser waveform, all 128 samples decoded, pause/resume/mute and music/SFX override/restore passed
tests.integratedGame: Start entered playing with WebGL error 0 and AudioContext running; no console errors or warnings observed
tests.resourcePanel: Actual Chrome file chooser replacement passed for music.stage1 and sfx.hit (impact). IndexedDB reload reached title without a gesture or loading stall; Start resumed audio. Both test overrides were restored to original.
tests.pitch: 8 source-pitch regression tests plus existing 10-minute looping test passed (9/9). Original 29564 event fields unchanged; 37 tracks and all tonal frequencies validated.

pitchCorrection.sourceVersion: User-provided original 2020 cartridge; the supplied gameplay video is the 2022 DX edition and is not the source of these note values.
pitchCorrection.cause: Sequence command 0x17 was mislabeled vib and ignored by native synthesis. The source uses it for a signed one-way pitch slide. Level 2 uses 132 audible slide events; ignoring these changes the melody and bass line.
pitchCorrection.notChanged: No blanket transposition. All 29564 note/onset/duration/gate/instrument/percussion events remain identical to the pre-correction data.

unchangedEventDigest.algorithm: SHA-256 of JavaScript JSON.stringify tracks mapped to [s,d,g,n,v,r,duty,ch,env,tie,sample-or-null]

sourceEvidence.meaning: 0x17 params = delay, interval, signed pitch step, signed semitone target; command resets cumulative slide offset.
Update signed slide by step in 1/16-semitone units and clamp at target; not an oscillating vibrato.
Key-off stops slide updates. A finished slide clears on the next note. Stored parameter bytes are not automatically retriggered.
Arpeggio adds signed semitones; pitch envelope and fine detune add signed 1/16-semitone values before table lookup.
0x14 is fine pitch. 0x15 is signed timer detune added after table conversion, where a positive value lowers the pitch.
97 little-endian table words. Odd 1/16-semitone positions average adjacent words; octave shifts use integer division. Triangle uses the same timer but twice the pulse divisor.

level2Examples.note: The first control frame includes the source arpeggio +12-semitone attack. The following note at 1.216216 seconds has no new slide.
This short note ends before the +36-semitone target. Key-off preserves the boundary; the next bass command starts independently.

pitchCorrection.limits: Native Web Audio synthesis, not CPU/APU emulation. Curves use the existing musical-event timeline on a 60 Hz control grid, not cycle-accurate hardware timing. Pulse-duty motion, noise color, hardware sweep and tied-note phase can still differ; original-vs-DX arrangements are not overwritten.
